description: Reads up to 100 active listings of an Etsy shop from Etsy's API and checks each one against Etsy's published title, tag and photo rules. Returns the shop's first problem and how many listings have it, per-listing issues, and Etsy's shop sales count (the shop's lifetime total, not per listing). Use for 'why is my Etsy shop not getting sales?' and 'what should I fix first?'.

shop.description: Etsy shop name or shop link

name: etsy_shop_audit
title: Audit an Etsy shop
